back.en: A set of vertices (points) connected by edges (lines)
back.bm: Set bucu (titik) yang disambung oleh tepi (garis)

back.en: Number of edges meeting it; a loop counts 2
back.bm: Bilangan tepi yang bertemu dengannya; gelung dikira 2

back.en: Edges have arrows showing direction (one-way roads, followers)
back.bm: Tepi mempunyai anak panah menunjukkan arah (jalan sehala, pengikut)

back.en: Some vertices and edges taken from a graph
back.bm: Sebahagian bucu dan tepi yang diambil daripada graf

back.en: Compare total weights of possible routes; fewest edges is not always shortest
back.bm: Bandingkan jumlah pemberat laluan yang mungkin; tepi paling sedikit tidak semestinya terpendek

back.en: Transport maps, social media, electricity grids, the internet, food webs
back.bm: Peta pengangkutan, media sosial, grid elektrik, internet, siratan makanan

back.en: Loop: an edge from a vertex back to itself. Multiple edges: two or more edges joining the same pair of vertices
back.bm: Gelung: tepi dari satu bucu kembali kepada dirinya. Berbilang tepi: dua atau lebih tepi yang menghubungkan pasangan bucu yang sama

front.en: Total degree of a graph with 7 edges

tip.en: Each edge adds 1 to the degree of both its ends.
tip.bm: Setiap tepi menambah 1 kepada darjah kedua-dua hujungnya.

back.en: In a directed graph: in-degree = arrows coming in; out-degree = arrows going out
back.bm: Dalam graf terarah: darjah masuk = anak panah masuk; darjah keluar = anak panah keluar

back.en: Every vertex can be reached from every other vertex along edges
back.bm: Setiap bucu boleh dicapai dari setiap bucu lain melalui tepi
